summary: Firefox consolidated its I420 and NV12 image-conversion pipelines and added explicit control over RGB-to-YUV matrices, color ranges, strides, rotations, and picture regions, improving correctness for video formats and color conversion. Media playback also became more reliable around seeking, reused audio streams, playback-rate changes, resampling quality, and shutdown message handling, while the former Feature Policy API and files were fully renamed to Permissions Policy.
